content.json:
## usnm BOINC
The BOINC server app and its jobs (bridge, gold bundle, app version publish, init, secrets), from `ContainerAppSystemLogs` and `ContainerAppConsoleLogs`, with legacy `_CL` table fallbacks, in this workspace. Times are UTC; the workspace keeps 30 days.

The BOINC daemons (feeder, transitioner, validators, assimilator, file deleter) are started by `bin/start` and write to log files on the project share, not to stdout, so their lines are not here. Work-volume samples are aggregate-only records emitted by the bridge's manual `work-volume` step; workunits are counted by their validation, assimilation and deletion flags, which can overlap. Active users and hosts match BOINC's status page definition (recent average credit above 1).

content.query:
let samples = union isfuzzy=true ContainerAppConsoleLogs, ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| extend App = coalesce(
    column_ifexists("ContainerAppName", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName", ""), column_ifexists("JobName", ""),
    column_ifexists("ContainerAppName_s", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName_s", ""), column_ifexists("JobName_s", "")),
    Msg = coalesce(column_ifexists("Log", ""), column_ifexists("Log_s", ""))
| where App startswith "usnm-boinc"
| distinct TimeGenerated, App, Msg
| where Msg contains "boinc_work_volume"
| extend m = parse_json(Msg)
| where tostring(m.event) == "boinc_work_volume"
| where toint(m.schema_version) == 1;
let latestSample = samples | top 1 by TimeGenerated desc;
latestSample
| project TimeGenerated,
    Workunits = tolong(m.workunits.total),
    ValidationNo = tolong(m.workunits.need_validate.no),
    ValidationYes = tolong(m.workunits.need_validate.yes),
    AssimilationInit = tolong(m.workunits.assimilate_state.init),
    AssimilationReady = tolong(m.workunits.assimilate_state.ready),
    AssimilationDone = tolong(m.workunits.assimilate_state.done),
    AssimilationOther = tolong(m.workunits.assimilate_state.other),
    FileDeletionInit = tolong(m.workunits.file_delete_state.init),
    FileDeletionReady = tolong(m.workunits.file_delete_state.ready),
    FileDeletionDone = tolong(m.workunits.file_delete_state.done),
    FileDeletionError = tolong(m.workunits.file_delete_state.error),
    FileDeletionOther = tolong(m.workunits.file_delete_state.other),
    Results = tolong(m.results.total),
    ResultInactive = tolong(m.results.server_state.inactive),
    ResultUnsent = tolong(m.results.server_state.unsent),
    ResultInProgress = tolong(m.results.server_state.in_progress),
    ResultOver = tolong(m.results.server_state.over),
    ResultOther = tolong(m.results.server_state.other),
    ActiveUsers = tolong(m.active_users),
    ActiveHosts = tolong(m.active_hosts)
content.title: Latest work-volume state counts

content.query:
let samples = union isfuzzy=true ContainerAppConsoleLogs, ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| extend App = coalesce(
    column_ifexists("ContainerAppName", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName", ""), column_ifexists("JobName", ""),
    column_ifexists("ContainerAppName_s", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName_s", ""), column_ifexists("JobName_s", "")),
    Msg = coalesce(column_ifexists("Log", ""), column_ifexists("Log_s", ""))
| where App startswith "usnm-boinc"
| distinct TimeGenerated, App, Msg
| where Msg contains "boinc_work_volume"
| extend m = parse_json(Msg)
| where tostring(m.event) == "boinc_work_volume"
| where toint(m.schema_version) == 1;
let latestSample = samples | top 1 by TimeGenerated desc;
latestSample
| mv-expand Tile = pack_array(
    pack("Name", "Workunits", "Value", todouble(m.workunits.total)),
    pack("Name", "Workunits not needing validation", "Value", todouble(m.workunits.need_validate.no)),
    pack("Name", "Workunits waiting validation", "Value", todouble(m.workunits.need_validate.yes)),
    pack("Name", "Workunits ready to assimilate", "Value", todouble(m.workunits.assimilate_state.ready)),
    pack("Name", "Workunits ready for file deletion", "Value", todouble(m.workunits.file_delete_state.ready)),
    pack("Name", "Results", "Value", todouble(m.results.total)),
    pack("Name", "Inactive results", "Value", todouble(m.results.server_state.inactive)),
    pack("Name", "Unsent results", "Value", todouble(m.results.server_state.unsent)),
    pack("Name", "Results in progress", "Value", todouble(m.results.server_state.in_progress)),
    pack("Name", "Completed results", "Value", todouble(m.results.server_state.over)),
    pack("Name", "Active users", "Value", todouble(m.active_users)),
    pack("Name", "Active hosts", "Value", todouble(m.active_hosts)))
| project Name = tostring(Tile.Name), Value = todouble(Tile.Value)
content.title: Latest work volume

content.query:
let samples = union isfuzzy=true ContainerAppConsoleLogs, ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| extend App = coalesce(
    column_ifexists("ContainerAppName", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName", ""), column_ifexists("JobName", ""),
    column_ifexists("ContainerAppName_s", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName_s", ""), column_ifexists("JobName_s", "")),
    Msg = coalesce(column_ifexists("Log", ""), column_ifexists("Log_s", ""))
| where App startswith "usnm-boinc"
| distinct TimeGenerated, App, Msg
| where Msg contains "boinc_work_volume"
| extend m = parse_json(Msg)
| where tostring(m.event) == "boinc_work_volume"
| where toint(m.schema_version) == 1;
samples
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Msg) by Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
| extend TimeGenerated = Bucket, m = parse_json(Msg)
| project TimeGenerated,
    Workunits = tolong(m.workunits.total),
    WaitingValidation = tolong(m.workunits.need_validate.yes),
    AssimilationReady = tolong(m.workunits.assimilate_state.ready),
    FileDeletionReady = tolong(m.workunits.file_delete_state.ready),
    Results = tolong(m.results.total),
    ResultsInactive = tolong(m.results.server_state.inactive),
    ResultsUnsent = tolong(m.results.server_state.unsent),
    ResultsInProgress = tolong(m.results.server_state.in_progress),
    ResultsOver = tolong(m.results.server_state.over),
    ActiveUsers = tolong(m.active_users),
    ActiveHosts = tolong(m.active_hosts)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Work-volume samples over time

content.query:
let sys = union isfuzzy=true ContainerAppSystemLogs, ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL
| extend App = coalesce(
    column_ifexists("ContainerAppName", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName", ""), column_ifexists("JobName", ""),
    column_ifexists("ContainerAppName_s", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName_s", ""), column_ifexists("JobName_s", "")),
    Revision = coalesce(column_ifexists("RevisionName", ""), column_ifexists("RevisionName_s", "")),
    Replica = coalesce(column_ifexists("ReplicaName", ""), column_ifexists("ReplicaName_s", "")),
    Reason = coalesce(column_ifexists("Reason", ""), column_ifexists("Reason_s", "")),
    Kind = coalesce(column_ifexists("Type_s", ""), column_ifexists("Type", "")),
    Msg = coalesce(column_ifexists("Log", ""), column_ifexists("Log_s", ""))
| where App startswith "usnm-boinc"
| distinct TimeGenerated, App, Revision, Replica, Reason, Kind, Msg;
sys
| where App contains "-caj-"
| summarize First = min(TimeGenerated), Warnings = countif(Kind == "Warning"), arg_max(TimeGenerated, Reason) by Job = App
| project Job, First, Last = TimeGenerated, LastReason = Reason, Warnings
| order by First desc
content.title: Job activity by last event

| extend App = coalesce(
    column_ifexists("ContainerAppName", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName", ""), column_ifexists("JobName", ""),
    column_ifexists("ContainerAppName_s", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName_s", ""), column_ifexists("JobName_s", "")),
    Revision = coalesce(column_ifexists("RevisionName", ""), column_ifexists("RevisionName_s", "")),

let sys = union isfuzzy=true ContainerAppSystemLogs, ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL
| extend App = coalesce(
    column_ifexists("ContainerAppName", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName", ""), column_ifexists("JobName", ""),

| extend App = coalesce(
    column_ifexists("ContainerAppName", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName", ""), column_ifexists("JobName", ""),
    column_ifexists("ContainerAppName_s", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName_s", ""), column_ifexists("JobName_s", "")),

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true ContainerAppConsoleLogs, ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| extend App = coalesce(
    column_ifexists("ContainerAppName", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName", ""), column_ifexists("JobName", ""),
    column_ifexists("ContainerAppName_s", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName_s", ""), column_ifexists("JobName_s", "")),
    Msg = coalesce(column_ifexists("Log", ""), column_ifexists("Log_s", ""))
| where App startswith "usnm-boinc"
| distinct TimeGenerated, App, Msg
| where Msg has_any ("error", "fail", "failed", "failure", "usnm-boinc:")
| where Msg !has "IDENTITY_HEADER" and Msg !has "MSI_SECRET"
| project TimeGenerated, App, Msg
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Job and app errors in console output
